title: 第642章 大人饶命啊第641章 露馅的太快了吧
slug: 符心护剑重建三十三重天
content_zh:
“小小童子，前倨后恭，真当我拿你没办法吗？”
台座上的黑影淡淡开口，话音落下，缓步上前，掌心托起张宗蛰遗留下来的储物袋，袋口灵光轻敞。
储物袋中有些许修行资粮，不过对苏醒来说，没有什么意义。
影子手腕一翻，那只盛着碧绿化金水的水晶瓶悬浮半空，瓶内绿水微微翻涌。
“方才那人只敢拿此物当作谈判筹码，百般试探，处处留手，可我不一样，我真的会用。”
清源童子见状非但没有半分畏惧，反倒周身淡红丹火尽数舒展，小小的灵体往丹炉方向退了两步，伸手指向身后那尊五米高的天外丹炉，语气嚣张至极：
“来，来来，尽管动手，区区凡间腐蚀化金水，也妄图消融我仙庭神金浇筑的随军丹炉。简直是痴心妄想！”
“呵呵，倒是我小气了。”
影子全然不在意对方的挑衅，随手将水晶瓶收进储物袋中，瞬间激活了养符空间里的一张【诛魂符】。
裹挟两百多万精纯精神力【诛魂符】，被140级【制符术】提高14倍威能的狂暴精神洪流骤然席卷而出，直扑清源童子灵体。
清源童子只是微微一怔，随即嗤笑出声，灵体表层丹火轻轻一荡，便将这道精神冲击尽数承受，眉眼间满是不屑：
“就这点力道，跟给我挠痒痒没有区别。一介下界凡人，也想凭借符箓损伤仙庭器灵，未免太过异想天开。”
影子嘴角勾起一抹冷淡笑意，没有多言，指尖符光接连不断亮起。
十张打过去……
百张打过去……
千张打过去……
苏醒怕一下子把这童子打坏了，但是显然，他太小看眼前这丹炉器灵了。
直到一千四百张【诛魂符】同步引燃，无边无际的精神浪潮如同倾覆星海，层层叠叠碾压向清源童子。
无声无息的精神冲击不断砸在清源童子的灵体之上，淡红色丹火屏障剧烈震颤、明暗交替。
原本从容嚣张的面色终于一点点发白，灵体在空中不受控制地左右摇晃，身形都出现了些许透明虚化的迹象。

可他依旧咬着牙硬撑，强压下神魂深处翻涌的刺痛，梗着嗓子放话：“数量倒是不少，可惜力量无法拧成一股，落了下乘。”
“有本事便继续，我倒要瞧瞧，这般消耗神魂的攻势，你能支撑多久。”
“如你所愿，这般攻击，我可以无休止地持续下去。”
影子语气平静无波，眼底毫无波澜，心中了然，这器灵童子果然不一般，多半已是仙器级别了。
当然，这只是苏醒的臆想，对方所说的仙庭的力量体系，他一无所知。
这个清源童子且不说他的本身价值，光是他所知的信息，就是一笔无比庞大的财富，他一定要收服他。
影子的养符空间之内，囤积百万张【诛魂符】，储备充足。
更何况山体之外，尚有四道待命的影子分身，每一道都携带着海量符箓库存，可以源源不断供给火力。
content_en:
"You little boy, you are so naughty at first and respectful at the other, do you really think I can't do anything to you?"
The dark figure on the pedestal spoke lightly. After the words fell, he slowly stepped forward and held up the storage bag left by Zhang Zongzhe in his palm. The mouth of the bag was lightly illuminated.
There are some cultivation materials in the storage bag, but for Su Xing, they are of little significance.
Shadow flipped his wrist, and the crystal bottle containing turquoise golden water was suspended in the air, and the green water inside the bottle surged slightly.
"That person just now only dared to use this thing as a bargaining chip, testing it in every possible way, and holding back at every turn, but I am different, I really know how to use it."
When the Qingyuan boy saw this, not only was he not afraid at all, but the reddish alchemy fire all over his body stretched out. The little spirit took two steps back towards the alchemy furnace, pointed at the five-meter-high heavenly alchemy furnace behind him, and spoke in an extremely arrogant tone:
"Come, come, come on, you can use your hands to corrode the gold water in the mortal world, but you are also trying to dissolve the army alchemy furnace made of the divine gold of my fairy court. It is simply a wishful thinking!"
"Haha, I'm stingy."
Shadow didn't care about the other party's provocation at all, and casually put the crystal bottle into the storage bag, and instantly activated a [Soul-killing Talisman] in the Talisman Raising Space.
Embracing more than two million pure spiritual power [Soul-killing Talisman], a violent spiritual torrent that was increased 14 times in power by the level 140 [Talk-Making Technique] suddenly swept out and attacked Qingyuan Boy's spirit body.
The Qingyuan boy was just slightly startled, and then he laughed out loud. The elixir fire on the surface of his spirit body swayed slightly, and he withstood all the mental impact, with disdain on his face:
"With this little strength, it's no different from tickling me. It would be too fanciful for a mortal from the lower realm to use a talisman to damage the spirit of the Immortal Garden."
A cold smile appeared on the corner of Shadow's mouth. Without saying anything, the talisman lights on his fingertips lit up one after another.
Call ten...
Call a hundred cards...
Call Qianzhang...
Su Xing was afraid that he would break the boy at once, but obviously, he underestimated the alchemy furnace spirit in front of him.
Until one thousand four hundred [Soul-killing Talismans] were ignited simultaneously, the boundless spiritual wave was like overturning the sea of ​​​​stars, crushing towards Qingyuan Boy layer by layer.
Silent spiritual shocks continued to hit Qingyuan Boy's spiritual body, and the light red pill fire barrier trembled violently, alternating between light and dark.
The originally calm and arrogant complexion finally turned white a little bit, the spirit body swayed uncontrollably from side to side in the air, and the figure showed some signs of becoming transparent and blurred.
But he still gritted his teeth and held on, suppressing the stinging pain deep in his soul, and said in a choked voice: "The number is quite large, but it's a pity that the strength cannot be twisted into one, so it is inferior."
"Continue if you can. I want to see how long you can sustain such a soul-consuming offensive."
"As you wish, I can continue this attack endlessly."
Shadow's tone was calm, and there was no wave in his eyes. He knew clearly in his heart that this spirit boy was indeed extraordinary, and was probably at the level of an immortal weapon.
Of course, this was just Su Xing's imagination. He knew nothing about the power system of Immortal Court mentioned by the other party.
Not to mention the value of this Qingyuan boy, the information he knew alone was an extremely huge wealth. He must conquer him.
There are millions of [Soul-killing Talismans] stored in Shadow's Talisman Raising Space, and the reserve is sufficient.
What's more, there are four shadow clones on standby outside the mountain, each carrying a massive inventory of talismans, which can continuously supply firepower.
